question: Can an existing repository adopt causal Git memory and durable agent work state without changing its language, package manager or legacy history?
hypothesis: One idempotent init command plus a reusable CI workflow can establish causal history, durable WORK refs and integration-boundary rules while exempting only the bootstrap commit.

decision.reason: Init is idempotent and preserves existing agent instructions. A legacy-style fixture accepted one unstructured adoption commit, generated a report and Git-note evidence without rewriting history or changing the target stack. A paired same-tree test then rejected the next unstructured commit for exactly six missing causal trailers while accepting the identical structured change, proving the bootstrap exemption is one-shot.
